frames.label: 2022 drills era
frames.note: The story begins with the Pelosi visit and Beijing's normalized large-scale encirclement exercises. Tensions read as a new baseline of constant military activity around the island. This is the frame Taipei and Washington open with when discussing current military pressure.

frames.label: 1996 crisis
frames.note: The story begins with the third Strait crisis and Taiwan's first direct democratic election. Tensions read as Beijing pressuring a self-governing democracy it has never ruled - foundational to Taiwanese self-description and Western support arguments.

frames.label: 1979 switch
frames.note: The story begins with the US recognition switch to Beijing and the Taiwan Relations Act - a great-power promise to another power's territory. Tensions read as an unresolved strategic ambiguity. This frames debate inside Washington policy circles.

frames.label: 1949 split
frames.note: The story begins with the Republic of China's retreat to Taiwan. Tensions read as unfinished civil war and, in Beijing's telling, the last step of restoring national sovereignty and territorial unity - the PRC's official frame in diplomatic discourse.

The story begins centuries back - Dutch, Qing, Japanese rule. The island's history reads as layered colonizations; whether 'Taiwan has always been part of China' or 'Taiwan was a Japanese colony integrated into postwar Asia' depends on where the story starts.
